qs.q: Which of the following findings is a component of the Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome (SIRS) criteria?
o: Heart rate higher than 90 beats per minute
Serum lactate greater than 2 mmol per liter
Platelet count less than 100,000 per microliter
qs.e: SIRS criteria include a heart rate higher than 90/min, alongside temperature extremes, abnormal hyperventilation, and abnormal white blood cell counts. Hypotension and lactate are part of shock or organ dysfunction definitions.

qs.q: Which clinical finding is part of the systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) criteria?
o: Systolic blood pressure less than 100 mm Hg
Body temperature higher than 38°C or lower than 36°C
Respiratory rate greater than 25 breaths per minute
Platelet count lower than 100,000 cells per microliter
qs.e: SIRS criteria include body temperature higher than 38°C or lower than 36°C, along with heart rate, respiration, and WBC abnormalities. Blood pressure thresholds are not part of the standard SIRS definition.
